notes.title: Lunar Mirror 2023.1.13 finalized
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
Due to various reasons, the release date of "Lunar mirror", which has been delayed for a long time, has [h2]finally been confirmed! The game will be officially launched on the afternoon of January 13, 2023![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/_/
"Lunar Mirror " is a horror, suspense and decryption game with the theme of Cthulhu on campus. Nishimura Qiren's girlfriend mysteriously disappeared on campus. With the help of his friends, Qiren discovered that the disappearance of his girlfriend was linked to the school's weird clubs that are keen on organizing "late night fellowship". As the investigation deepened, strange events happened one after another. , The huge conspiracy behind it also slowly surfaced...
If you can't wait to experience it first, the demo is now on the game store, and you can download and play for free.

[h2]At the same time, let's preview that "Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" will also be launched soon![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157680/_/?curator_clanid=34942634
This game is a derivative work of "Lunar Mirror", telling the story of how mysterious religions develop believers through societies. The gameplay is the same as that of Lunar Mirror which complements some of the story settings of Mirror of the Moon. If you like this type of game, please add it to the wishlist first.

notes.title: 11-22 Game Update
notes.content:
[b]This update is mainly to fix the problem that when the game is running on a non-English, Chinese, or Japanese system, the game will be black and the rabbit will be infinitely loaded.[/b]

Sorry for players with languages other than English, Chinese and Japanese. Due to the inexperience of the developers, the game has not been tested on more language systems, which brings bad game experience to players.
If you have any other stuck issues, please let us know in Discord.

notes.title: 11-17 The new bug has been fixed, please update the game
notes.content:
hi gentlemen
[h2]The bug cannot be continued after the phone is unlocked. It has been fixed. Please restart steam and update the game to continue.[/h2]
Our programmers have updated again and fixed some bugs:
1. Fix the problem that the mouse label of the game content is lost due to the installation of the handle, such as the problem of wiping tears and the main menu without the mouse label
2. Optimize the resolution setting, now you can configure more ratio monitors
3. Optimized resource loading, such as turning green Saiyan collapse
4. Added guidance hints to some mini-games
Players who have manually installed the plugin before, please reinstall it.

notes.title: Update Instructions
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
After our programmers worked hard for 1 day and 1 night, we fixed some bugs:
1. Fixed the problem that the story could not be advanced after watching the video game in chat.
2. Fixed the stuck problem of wiping tears, changing Saiyan and other loading points.
3. Re-adjusted the game adaptive resolution so that it can adapt to more types of monitors
Some players encounter the situation that the finger cannot connect to the mobile phone video call, you can solve it in the main menu - click the well cover, open the settings menu - switch the vertical synchronization switch of the game. This is due to the high frame rate of some graphics cards.

If you encounter a tear-wiping card master, it may be that the system recognizes the handle. After unplugging the handle, you can drag it with the mouse.
